Auckland Council @AklCouncil Apr 10 Cyclone Vaianu | We're urging Aucklanders to get prepared and have a plan ahead of the cyclone arriving in Aotearoa New Zealand. ℹ️ Find out more about this here: tinyurl.com/5xztahmz Auckland Council @AklCouncil May 13, 2025 Our website will be down 14 May from 1am until 4am. Apologies for the inconvenience. Auckland Council @AklCouncil May 12, 2025 Public GeoMaps and other GIS services such as our websites, GIS web maps, and apps will be unavailable on Tuesday, 13 May from 6pm - 10pm. We apologise for the inconvenience. Auckland Council @AklCouncil Apr 19, 2025 Saturday 19 April 2025 | Severe Thunderstorm Watch to 6pm. Aucklanders, things are moving fast and it's important that you're ready and know where to get the latest updates and report issues. ⚠️ If your life or property is at risk, phone 111. Official Facebook page for Auckland Emergency Management. Follow us for emergency updates and... Auckland Council @AklCouncil Apr 19, 2025 How to report issues: 💻 Report fallen trees on public property via Auckland Council Report a Problem tool: aucklandcouncil.govt.nz/report-problem… ☎️ Report flooding and blocked stormwater drains on 09 301 0101. [3/3] Auckland Council reposted Auckland Emergency Management (AEM) @AucklandCDEM Apr 19, 2025 ℹ️ It is important to stay connected and informed when severe weather approaches, especially when it moves quickly. We apologise for the inconvenience.
